name: Stromboli

ingredients.name: roasted red bell pepper, drained and sliced
vegetarian mozzarella made with vegetarian coagulants, grated

steps: Mix flour, yeast, water, salt and 15 ml olive oil into a dough. Knead for 8–10 minutes until smooth and elastic. Cover and leave in a warm place for 60–75 minutes until noticeably doubled. Check the mozzarella label to ensure it uses microbial or other vegetarian coagulants.

Meanwhile heat 5 ml olive oil in a wide pan. Cook the sliced mushrooms over medium-high heat for 5–7 minutes until their liquid evaporates and the edges brown. Add garlic and spinach; cook 2–3 minutes until the leaves wilt. Transfer to a sieve and cool completely, pressing out excess moisture. Pat the drained roasted pepper strips dry.

Heat the oven to 220°C and line a baking tray. Roll the risen dough on a lightly floured surface into a rectangle about 35 × 28 cm. Spread the thick tomato sauce thinly, leaving a 3 cm clear border. Scatter the dry mushroom-spinach mixture, roasted pepper and grated vegetarian mozzarella evenly over the sauce; keep the filling away from the edges.

Starting at a long edge, roll the dough tightly around the filling into one long cylinder. Pinch the seam and both ends firmly shut, then place seam-side down on the tray. Brush the outside with the remaining 5 ml olive oil, sprinkle with oregano and cut three shallow steam slits across the top.

Bake for 25–30 minutes until the crust is deep golden and fully cooked and the cheese bubbles through the slits. Rest on the tray for 10 minutes so the filling sets, then cut into thick diagonal slices. Serve warm, with extra tomato sauce on the side if desired.
tips: Cool and drain the cooked vegetables before rolling: wet filling makes the centre soggy and can split the crust. The reviewed image shows a sliced golden roll with visible spinach, mushrooms, red pepper, tomato and melted cheese.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
